title: Summer Camp Registration Now Open
excerpt: Our annual Kellogg's Cúl Camp returns to Staplestown from July 21st–25th. Places fill fast — register now to guarantee your spot.
body:
Our annual Kellogg's Cúl Camp returns to Staplestown from July 21st–25th, running 10am to 2pm each day for boys and girls aged 6 to 13.

Every child receives the official Cúl Camp kit and a week of football, fun and new friends, led by qualified coaches from the club.

Places fill fast every year — register through the official Kellogg's Cúl Camps website and select St. Kevin's, Staplestown as your venue.
